Vehicles.VehicleBuildDef.label: 순례자
Vehicles.VehicleBuildDef.description: 기본 광선포2기와 보호막을 갖춘 무인 운용 가능 초대형 왕복선 순례자를 건조합니다. 건조물의 최대 내구도20,000은 운행 기체의 부품별 내구도와 구분됩니다.

Vehicles.VehicleDef.label: 순례자
Vehicles.VehicleDef.description: 검은 삼각형 선체와 중앙의 진홍빛 눈을 갖춘 초대형 왕복선. 수렴 광선포2기와 사건지평 방벽,50,000Hu 열저장 및 자체 방열250Hu/s를 기본 탑재합니다. 조종사 없이 운용할 수 있으며 선택적으로 조종석에 탑승할 수 있습니다. 내장 무장과 방벽은 별도 장착 없이 사용할 수 있고 장갑·추진·화물·승객 설비는 추가 개량할 수 있습니다.

li.label: Minimal Armor
li.description: Retrofit the shuttle's hull to minimize weight, trading armor for speed and fuel efficiency.\n<color=#bb8f04>-10% blunt armor, -20% sharp armor, +6 flight speed, +0.5 ground speed, +100 cargo capacity, -10 fuel consumption rate</color>

li.label: Heavy Armor
li.description: Retrofit the shuttle's hull with additional armor plating.\n<color=#bb8f04>+40% blunt armor, +40% sharp armor, -6 flight speed, -0.5 ground speed, -250 cargo capacity, +10 fuel consumption rate</color>

li.label: Reactive Nano-Armor
li.description: Apply a layer of vibrating mechanite chains which helps to diffuse blunt impacts.\n<color=#bb8f04>+30% blunt armor, +10% sharp armor, -50 cargo capacity</color>

li.label: Archotech Armor
li.description:
[HUMAN CARAPACE
FROM THIS COCOON I EMERGE
TO WEAVE ONE STRONGER]
<color=#bb8f04>+50% blunt armor, +50% sharp armor</color>

li.label: Overdriven Engine
li.description: Boost reactor output and overdrive the primary engines.\n<color=#bb8f04>+12 flight speed, +1 ground move speed, +20 fuel consumption rate</color>

li.label: Auxiliary Thrusters
li.description: Installing additional thrusters improves the shuttle's chance of dodging enemy point-defense systems.\n<color=#bb8f04>+7% ship combat dodge chance, +5 fuel consumption rate</color>

li.label: M.U.L.E. Module
li.description: Utilize momentum-redirection technology to increase the mass of cargo this shuttle can carry, at the cost of greatly reduced flight speed.\n<color=#bb8f04>-8 flight speed, -0.66 ground move speed, +250 cargo capacity</color>

li.label: Archotech Engine
li.description:
[WHAT SAIL CARRIES YOU?
PUSH AGAINST WHICH FIRMAMENT?
THE ANSWER IS: YES]
<color=#bb8f04>+12 flight speed, +1 ground move speed, +13% ship combat dodge chance, +100 cargo capacity</color>

li.label: Onboard Auto-Doc
li.description: Install automated paramedic arms aboard the shuttle. These systems will quickly patch any bleeding wounds passengers may have suffered, but their tend quality is minimal.\n\n<color=#bb8f04>-250 cargo capacity</color>

li.label: Cloaking Device
li.description: Install a miniaturized cloaking device to improve dodge chance in combat. Its heatsinks also slightly boost shield capacity. When Odyssey is active, this device will also act as a signal jammer.\n<color=#bb8f04>+13% ship combat dodge chance, +50 heatsink, -500 cargo capacity</color>

li.label: Auxiliary Heatsink
li.description: Install an auxiliary heatsink to support shields.\n<color=#bb8f04>+200 heatsink, -100 cargo capacity</color>

li.label: Archotech Slipspace
li.description:
[BOX INSIDE A BOX
REPEAT AD INFINITUM
SERIES CONVERGES]
<color=#bb8f04>+500 cargo capacity</color>

li.label: Passenger Module (2)
li.description: Convert a small area of the cargo bay to seating and life support, allowing the shuttle to carry two passengers.\n<color=#bb8f04>+2 passenger capacity, -200 cargo capacity</color>

li.label: Passenger Module (4)
li.description: Convert a small area of the cargo bay to seating and life support, allowing the shuttle to carry four passengers.\n<color=#bb8f04>+4 passenger capacity, -400 cargo capacity</color>

li.label: Passenger Module (6)
li.description: Convert a moderate area of the cargo bay to seating and life support, allowing the shuttle to carry six passengers.\n<color=#bb8f04>+6 passenger capacity, -600 cargo capacity</color>

li.label: Passenger Module (8)
li.description: Convert a moderate area of the cargo bay to seating and life support, allowing the shuttle to carry eight passengers.\n<color=#bb8f04>+8 passenger capacity, -800 cargo capacity</color>

li.label: Passenger Module (10)
li.description: Convert a significant area of the cargo bay to seating and life support, allowing the shuttle to carry ten passengers.\n<color=#bb8f04>+10 passenger capacity, -1000 cargo capacity</color>

li.label: Passenger Module (12)
li.description: Convert a significant area of the cargo bay to seating and life support, allowing the shuttle to carry twelve passengers.\n<color=#bb8f04>+12 passenger capacity, -1200 cargo capacity</color>

li.label: Passenger Module (14)
li.description: Convert an enormous area of the cargo bay to seating and life support, allowing the shuttle to carry fourteen passengers.\n<color=#bb8f04>+14 passenger capacity, -1400 cargo capacity</color>

li.label: Passenger Module (16)
li.description: Convert an enormous area of the cargo bay to seating and life support, allowing the shuttle to carry sixteen passengers.\n<color=#bb8f04>+16 passenger capacity, -1600 cargo capacity</color>

Vehicles.VehicleTurretDef.label: 수렴 광선포
Vehicles.VehicleTurretDef.description: 순례자에 기본 탑재된 수렴 광선포. 비트당 피해75·30발 연사로 두 기의 합산 피해는150×30입니다. 지상 최소 사거리0·최대 사거리500, 함선전 최대 사거리100을 사용합니다. 사격에는 왕복선 연료를 사용합니다.
